description: Fix 'renderMemberSchedule is not defined' error in app.js. The function exists in member-schedule.js but app.js calls it incorrectly. In member-schedule.js line 7, renderMemberSchedule(container) expects a container parameter. But in app.js line 137 (case 'member-schedule'), it's called as await renderMemberSchedule(container) which should work. The issue is the function BODY (line 8-14) extracts memberId and then overwrites container.innerHTML, expecting to build the whole page. Verify the call signature matches and that member-schedule.js is loaded in index.html (it is - line 16 in index.html script includes).
steps: Read wwwroot/js/member-schedule.js lines 1-20 - function renderMemberSchedule(container) is defined at line 7
Read wwwroot/js/app.js lines 130-140 - case 'member-schedule' calls await renderMemberSchedule(container) at line 137
Read wwwroot/index.html lines 80-95 - verify <script src='js/member-schedule.js'> is NOT included (checked - it's missing!)
The root cause: member-schedule.js is NOT loaded in index.html, so the function is undefined at runtime
Add <script src='js/member-schedule.js'></script> in index.html after line 92 (after sessions.js, before checkins.js to maintain module order)
Verify the function signature matches: renderMemberSchedule(container) receives container from app.js
acceptance_criteria: member-schedule.js is loaded in index.html script tags
Page loads without 'renderMemberSchedule is not defined' error
Page displays schedule preferences grouped by day of week with create form and existing list
verification: Navigate to Lịch Tập Của Tôi (#member-schedule)
Verify page loads without console error

Create a new schedule preference - verify it appears in list grouped by day
